jobs.name: glasswharf_master_keyframe
jobs.brief: Wide establishing concept keyframe of Glass Wharf, a rain-soaked interspecies district in the noir metropolis of Black Meridian at night: dense waterfront warehouses converted into neon-lit clubs and black-market exchanges, an elevated transit line cutting overhead, wet asphalt reflecting cyan and amber signage, distant skyline of towering mixed human/alien architecture, heavy atmospheric fog, cinematic wide shot, moody teal-and-amber color grade, high-fidelity production concept art, no text, no logos.
